title: LionCredits
description: A custom currency named credits. Made for 1.21
body:
A plugin that adds a custom currency named credits. Supports Axtrade trading.
Drag and drop to add items to the shop.

PLAYERHOLDERS: 
%lioncredits_balance% 
%lioncredits_balance_<player>%

COMMANDS
- /creditshop
- /creditstop
- /credits
- /creditspay
- /creditseditshop
- /creditsadd
- /creditsremove

PERMS
- credits.use
- credits.admin
